theorem_rows.name: wheel_capacity_monotonicity
theorem_rows.statement: Increasing the wheel bound can only remove complement-pocket survivors and cannot weaken the gate Prime(hull)>WheelSurvivors(C).

theorem_rows.name: first_effective_wheel17_capacity_drop
theorem_rows.statement: On the finite residual frontier, adding 17 drops the maximum survivor requirement from 6 hull primes to 5 hull primes.

theorem_rows.name: post17_no_further_finite_drop
theorem_rows.statement: For tested bounds 19,23,29,31, the finite frontier does not improve beyond the wheel-17 capacity.

theorem_rows.name: global_wheel17_short_hull_lower_bound
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof still needs short hull prime counts beating wheel-17 pocket survivors, or exclusion of prime-support collapse.

plain_conclusion: 本步沿同一 hardpoint 做容量单调升级：把小轮从 13 升到 17 后，有限前沿的最大互补幸存容量从 5 降到 4，因此最大所需 hull 素数数从 6 降到 5；继续升到 19/23/29/31 在当前前沿没有进一步下降。这不是全局闭合，而是把下一硬点压成 wheel-17 固定孔袋短 hull 下界，或 prime-support collapse PDEC 排斥。

decision_rows.meaning: 轮筛升级只会减少互补孔袋容量，因此保持同一目标命题。
有限前沿中 17 是首个把最大所需 hull 素数数从 6 降到 5 的小轮。
仍需全局证明短 hull 素数数超过 wheel-17 互补幸存容量。
若短 hull 下界失败，仍需排斥所有 hull 素数被 wheel-17 孔袋吸收的支撑塌缩。
本步只压缩容量常数，不关闭全局行/列命题。
